note: Reviewed font sources for `designer-pipeline fonts`. Revisions are pinned; `fonts refresh` reads these files at these revisions. Bump a revision only after reviewing that commit.

OFL.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
OFL.conditions: Fonts may be used, embedded and modified, but not sold by themselves; a modified version (a subset counts) may not use a Reserved Font Name, if the licence text declares one, and must stay under the OFL.

APACHE2.name: Apache License 2.0
APACHE2.conditions: Keep the licence and NOTICE; state changes in modified files.

UFL.name: Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0
UFL.conditions: Modified versions must be renamed so they cannot be confused with the original.

sources.fetch: raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/<revision>/<directory>/<file>, read by HTTP Range (directory, cmap, name, OS/2, head, fvar, and the 十 glyph)
sources.licenseField: METADATA.pb `license` in the family directory, plus the licence text file beside it (OFL.txt, LICENSE.txt or UFL.txt)

discovery.note: Advisory: `fonts refresh --discover` lists Google Fonts families with these subsets that the registry does not list yet.

sources.scope: Every Google Fonts family whose subsets include chinese-simplified, chinese-traditional, chinese-hongkong or japanese on 2026-11-05 (97 families). Korean-only families are out of scope.

sources.reason: The repository holds only the Glyphs source and LICENSE.txt; built fonts are GitHub Release assets, and github.com/.../releases answered 403 through this proxy on 2026-11-05. Not bypassed. The catalog has no fangsong face until a reachable release host is reviewed.
Reachable (HTTP 200 on 2026-11-05). It mirrors Google Fonts metadata and serves unicode-range subsets (WOFF2 per subset), not whole files, so coverage is measured from google/fonts instead.

A curated list of free-for-commercial-use Chinese fonts (README). Its families come from many publishers with their own agreements; add one as a github-files source only after reading its licence at the publisher.
